title: remote-personal-supabase-ui 個人 Vercel → Supabase → 圖片下載與同步
mode: personal Vercel frontend + actual Supabase backend, demo composition
checks: 從部署的 App 實際呼叫 Supabase 文案端點，HTTP 200，使用明確標示的示範文案。
下載與解壓 1 張最終 PNG，核對像素、檔案大小與原圖雜湊。
從使用者個人 Vercel 部署完成實際 UI 操作、Supabase 文案回應、PNG ZIP 下載與商品／來源照片同步（201）。
遠端本案例為示範組版，沒有在 Supabase 宣稱真實 Gemini 呼叫成功。

outputs.title: 商品主圖
outputs.prompt:
Product: MORI 焙茶.
Supplied facts (do not invent additional claims): 示範包裝。茶葉商品。實際成分、重量與產地待商家補充。
Destination: Amazon; language: en; output: main; tone: natural; layout: smart; requested resolution: 1K.
Preserve the exact source product shape, color, logo, packaging, and visible details. Do not invent angles or claims not supported by the reference. Generate the photographic scene only, no new text. Text will be composed deterministically.
Pure white background. Entire product fully visible, centered. No props, badges, border or extra text.
Planned copy: A little more for your everyday | Make room for the things that fit your routine.
Merchant instructions: Use a clear, restrained product presentation.
